# PUBLIC MEETING NOTICE

DATED: September 10, 2010

The Regular Meeting of the HMUA will be held at 8:00 P.M., Tuesday, September 14, 2010, at the Jacob Garabed Administration Building located at 424 Hurley Drive in the Town of Hackettstown.

## THE AGENDA AS SCHEDULED FOLLOWS:

1. Chairperson calls meeting to order.
2. Executive Director conduct roll call.
3. Flag Salute.
4. Motion to approve the minutes of the August 10<sup>th</sup> Regular meeting.
5. Motion to approve the minutes of the August 10<sup>th</sup> Executive Session.
6. Open meeting to public participation.
7. Discussion and possible action to release a portion of the escrow retained for the Jane Paftinos, LLC project.
8. Chairperson entertain Resolution approving Operations Expense Account Requisitions #OEA-929, #OEA-930 and #OEA-931 in the total aggregate amount of \$305,216.35.
9. Chairperson entertain Resolution approving Construction Fund Requisition #CF-311 in an amount to be determined.
10. Chairperson entertain Resolution approving Construction Aid Fund Requisition #CAF-334 in an amount to be determined.
11. Chairperson entertain Resolution approving Renewal & Replacement Fund Requisition #RR-153 in an amount to be determined.
12. Chairperson entertain Resolution approving Escrow Subaccount Requisition #ESR-204 in an amount to be determined.
13. Discussion and possible to adopt a revised Section 125 Premium Only Plan with Opt Out Provision.
14. Report of Executive Director.
15. Report of Counselor.
16. Report of Projects Engineer.
17. Business of a general nature or not previously anticipated.
18. Chairperson shall entertain motion to adjourn.
